## Memory.wiki's Three-Tier Architecture

Memory.wiki uses a **Capture / Digestion / Utilization** (수집/소화/활용) framework:

**Tier 1: 수집 (Capture)**
Collects markdown from multiple surfaces — web app, Chrome extension, VS Code extension, desktop app, CLI, MCP server, GitHub import, drag-and-drop. Documents become addressable URLs.

**Tier 2: 소화 (Digestion)**
AI automatically builds the knowledge graph — concept extraction on every doc save, bundle graph analysis (themes, insights, typed edges), embeddings for semantic search, and concept relations accumulation across bundles. All happens in the background.

**Tier 3: 활용 (Utilization)**
Delivers knowledge to any AI via URL:
- `memory.wiki/<id>` — single document
- `memory.wiki/b/<id>` — bundle (Compact/Full)
- `memory.wiki/hub/<slug>` — full hub
- MCP server with 26 tools for deep integration

Each tier maps to a pricing level (Free/Pro/Build) and functions as a funnel: capture is the entry point, digestion drives engagement, and utilization creates lock-in through platform dependency.
